goal: Preserve 690 slow-drag smoothness while reducing rapid internal-split and outer-window frame collapse by removing same-frame forced-reflow and duplicate observer work, without visual proxies or speed throttling.

internalSplit: keep existing rAF latest-position split geometry
remove per-frame post-width scrollTop read/write guard
disable browser scroll anchoring during Lite drag
restore captured scroll position once after drag
outerResize: remove redundant JS modal-host viewport writes already overridden by fixed CSS
remove duplicate forced pane-width event after applyPercent
skip per-frame external control querySelector/temp-write-clear cycle; update split toggles only
pause SecondaryScrollControl document geometry reads until resize end
disable result-pane scroll anchoring for Music Note/Library during native resize

verification.fullViteBuild: not run: node_modules absent in ZIP workspace

userTest: Music Note internal splitter: slow movement should feel identical to 690
Music Note internal splitter: rapid left-right movement should have fewer large frame stalls
Library internal splitter: same two checks
Music Note/Library outer window: slow resize unchanged; rapid PC↔tablet resize should reduce stall
scroll position must not jump vertically during/after splitter drag
detail modal and collapse toggles must remain correctly positioned
